name: Porbandar

queries.query: Porbandar Gujarat official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official District Porbandar land-records page, which directs users to Gujarat's AnyRoR service. The official DILRMP district status page reports Porbandar taluka cadastral maps as digitized, geo-referenced, linked to RoR, and covering 80,208 land parcels. The official Gujarat Revenue Department IORA service page was also identified, but its host timed out during direct retrieval. No public Gujarat parcel API or safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

queries.query: પોરબંદર ગુજરાત સત્તાવાર કેડાસ્ટ્રલ નકશો જમીન રેકોર્ડ ભુનકશા
queries.result: Gujarati-language discovery did not surface a separate public parcel geometry endpoint. The official district land-records page remains the first-party local custodian route and points to AnyRoR; national BhuNaksha documentation lists Gujarat under CollabLand implementation, but does not provide a public Porbandar parcel service.

researchNote: A first-party local registry/custodian is evidenced by the official District Porbandar land-records page and Gujarat Revenue Department routes. DILRMP provides district/taluka coverage evidence, not parcel geometry for the exact WUP point. The public AnyRoR/IORA route was unavailable or timed out in bounded anonymous GET attempts, and no public map JavaScript/configuration or parcel API was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
